section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining the psychometric properties of the BAS-2 among adolescents and young adults across three countries: Denmark, Portugal, and Sweden. The study found that the BAS-2 has a single-factor structure across all three countries and both sexes, with partial scalar invariance across countries and between genders. Results showed that body appreciation is positively associated with self-esteem, psychological well-being, and intuitive eating, though the relationship with BMI varied by country (negative in Portugal, non-significant in Denmark and Sweden).
